summary: When Nora already looked something up and asks for a file, she now gets one reminder to hand along the real numbers instead of just retyping her own draft.
details: If she gathered a place's rating or a route's duration this turn and then asks for a file without passing that data along, she's nudged once to pass it properly before the job runs.
limitations: One nudge only — if she still doesn't pass it along the second time, the file still gets built from whatever she wrote.
